title: Картка особи, місця або установи
fields_and_relations: Різні профілі особи/місця/установи, доказові факти, дві схеми районування.
required_interaction: Суперечливі біографічні факти видимі як свідчення; говір не стає властивістю person.

implementation.view_model: Type-specific editable basic profiles; source names; linked materials; history Settlement directory: full administrative labels, historical-name/code search, sourced current and chronological descriptions, coordinates, foreign/disappeared places and multiple regional concepts. Existing sessions retain recorded wording.
limitations: Browser-local storage only; synthetic examples; no register import or automatic reconciliation with D11/D20. Regional assignments and external identifiers are append-only in this first interface.
Conflicting evidence-backed person facts remain pending.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store; fixture version 9
permissions: field.write or catalog.write in archive scope; vocabulary.write for terms
Settlement mutations require catalog.write in the archive; expected revision prevents stale edits.
implementation.atomicity: Authorize, expected revision, clone, validate, hash, commit. No partial mutation on failure.
